title: Problem edit batch
description: Input for the Discord command /problem edit_batch. The document is a JSON array; each entry updates only the supplied fields of an existing problem. Each entry requires problem_id and at least one editable field. Omitted fields retain their current values; null clears difficulty, topic, or priority. Repeated problem IDs are applied in array order. If storage fails, earlier entries may already have been applied; inspect the current state before retrying.

problem_id.description: ID of an existing problem to edit (problems[].id in the class export).

class.description: Optional destination class code. If supplied, it must exist in classes.json; omit it to keep the current class.

name.description: Optional problem name; omit it to keep the current name.

url.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the problem statement; omit it to keep the current URL.

difficulty.description: Optional difficulty; omit it to keep the current value, or use null to clear it.

topic.description: Optional topic patch; omit it to preserve the current value, supply a non-blank specific topic to update it, or use null only when intentionally clearing it. Do not use "General".

priority.description: Optional priority; omit it to keep the current value, or use null to clear it.
